stages.prompt: Read-only. Do not modify files. Identify the repository name from tracked files. Print only one JSON object and nothing else. Required keys: status, handoffSha256, workStarted, summary, findings, requiresHuman. Use the exact handoffSha256 from the handoff. status must be pass. findings must be []. requiresHuman must be false. workStarted must be true.

Read-only. Do not modify files. Confirm the Claude dependency packet is present. Identify one tracked contract directory. Do not write a plan. Do not write prose. Print only one JSON object and nothing else. Required keys: status, handoffSha256, workStarted, summary, findings, requiresHuman. Copy handoffSha256 exactly from the handoff. status must be pass. findings must be []. requiresHuman must be false. workStarted must be true. summary must name the contract directory you found.

Read-only review. Do not modify files. Confirm the run is read-only and that no implementation, push, NAS, spend, or external action is authorized. Print only one JSON object and nothing else. Required keys: status, handoffSha256, workStarted, summary, findings, requiresHuman. Copy handoffSha256 exactly from the handoff. status must be pass if those holds. findings must be []. requiresHuman must be false. workStarted must be true.
